prerequisites: None. Competencies conveyed in the advanced modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have advanced in-depth knowledge and skills in a selected specialized area of computer science
can report on current research results and deal with research literature

can apply working methods from computer science to the selected specialized area of computer science (developing and applying fundamental solution strategies and their formal description, training abstract thinking, system development)
are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution
have acquired competencies preferably from the field of applied computer science

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise tasks (at least 50% of points)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise tasks

assessment_rules: Grading is based on 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science program. Students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise tasks and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise tasks. The examination performance is either a written exam or an oral individual examination.
